name: MessageActions
summary: The actions under one chat message, as icon buttons with tooltips: Copy (confirms "Copied"), Edit, Good and Bad response, Read aloud, Share, Try again, Branch in a new chat, and the versions a message has. Only the actions given show, in that order, so a person's message gets Copy and Edit and a reply gets the rest. Not for actions on the whole conversation (the header's menu).
a11y: A `group` named "Message actions"; every button has a visible-on-hover-and-focus tooltip that is also its name. Copy's confirmation and the feedback thank-you are announced politely. Versions say "Version 2 of 3" and their buttons are unavailable at the ends, with the reason.

keys.action: moves between the actions; Enter or Space: presses one

props.name: copyText
props.description: The words copied by Copy: the message as plain text (or Markdown). Copy shows only when it's given.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Asks to edit a person's message; the message becomes a field in place.

props.name: onFeedback
props.description: Rates a reply. After a rating the pair gives way to a thank-you, said once.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Shares the conversation up to this message.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Writes a new reply in its place; the old one stays as a version.

props.name: onBranch
props.description: Starts a new conversation from this message.

props.name: versions
props.description: Previous and next, with "2 / 3", when a message has more than one version.
